explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial ended in S2, usually after choosing a2: then it is about 8-10 whether or not that trial was rewarded, starting near 0-2 and climbing to 8-10 over the first one or two trials of a new run of a2 choices. It drops to about 6, then 5, then 2 after 2-3 unrewarded trials in a row, is only 1-3 if S2 was reached rarely after choosing a1, and is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at any D1 after reaching S1, and near the very end of the episode (around trial 95 and later).
